atoms.text: Tropical parts of South Asia experience a wet and a dry season each year. This is caused by a monsoon, which is a seasonal change in wind direction.
From May to October, monsoon winds bring heavy rains. However, for the rest of the year, the winds reverse and keep the weather dry.
